text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"—The Japan Cup... I gave it my all, and 
I'm sure City-san did too. We both ran a 
race that made us truly love who we are!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Right after getting all that cheering and 
applause, Mifuyu-chan contacted me. She 
told me she passed her badge test...!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna be a 'City Girl.' Mifuyu-chan 
is aiming for the world skating 
championship. ...Together, we've taken a 
step closer to our dreams!!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Mom, Dad. I'm real sorry for makin' you 
worry. But... I'm okay now. 'Cause right 
now, I love who I am more than ever!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Th-That's why I can't let it end here, no 
siree. From here on out, I'm gonna give it 
everything I've got and spark a huge 
boom!"
